interpretation_ko: 새 계약을 맺어 이득을 볼 조짐
interpretation_en: is a sign that you will enter into new contracts, which will prove profitable

cite.original: To dream that you rent a house, is a sign that you will enter into new contracts, which will prove profitable.
cite.translation_ko: 집을 빌리는 꿈은, 새 계약을 맺어 이득을 볼 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that there will be much inactivity in business

cite.original: To fail to rent out property, denotes that there will be much inactivity in business.
cite.translation_ko: 재산을 세놓지 못하는 꿈은, 사업이 크게 침체될 조짐이다

interpretation_en: signifies that your financial interest will be satisfactory

cite.original: To pay rent, signifies that your financial interest will be satisfactory.
cite.translation_ko: 집세를 내는 꿈은, 재정 상태가 만족스러울 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 장사가 기울고 사교 생활의 즐거움도 별 도움이 안 될 불운한 조짐
interpretation_en: it is unlucky for you, as you will see a falling off in trade, and social pleasures will be of little benefit

cite.original: If you can't pay your rent, it is unlucky for you, as you will see a falling off in trade, and social pleasures will be of little benefit.
cite.translation_ko: 집세를 내지 못하는 꿈은, 장사가 기울고 사교 생활의 즐거움도 별 도움이 안 될 불운한 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 불안하게 하던 어려움을 이겨 낼 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells that you will overcome some difficulty which is causing you anxiety

cite.original: To be under sentence in a dream and receive a reprieve, foretells that you will overcome some difficulty which is causing you anxiety.
cite.translation_ko: 형을 선고받았는데 집행유예를 받는 꿈은, 불안하게 하던 어려움을 이겨 낼 조짐이다

context: 처녀에게 정인이 집행유예를 받는 꿈이 나타남
interpretation_ko: 정인에게 중요한 좋은 소식을 곧 듣게 될 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that she will soon hear of some good luck befalling him, which will be of vital interest to her

cite.original: For a young woman to dream that her lover has been reprieved, denotes that she will soon hear of some good luck befalling him, which will be of vital interest to her.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀에게 정인이 집행유예를 받는 꿈이 나타나면, 정인에게 중요한 좋은 소식을 곧 듣게 될 조짐이다
